-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Excalidraw API key and connectivity.

list-scenes.name: list-scenes
list-scenes.description: List all Excalidraw scenes in the workspace with their metadata and links. Supports pagination via cursor.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous response to get the next page.
params.limit: Maximum number of scenes to return per page (default: 50).

get-scene.name: get-scene
get-scene.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific Excalidraw scene by its ID, including links and sharing settings.

get-scene-content.name: get-scene-content
get-scene-content.description: Retrieve the complete drawing content of an Excalidraw scene: all elements (shapes, text, arrows, etc.), app state, and embedded files.

params.sceneId: The scene ID whose content to retrieve.

create-scene.name: create-scene
create-scene.description: Create a new empty Excalidraw scene with specified metadata. Optionally assign it to a collection and pin it. Returns the created scene with its ID and sharing links.

params.name: Name for the new scene.
params.collectionId: ID of the collection to place the scene in.
params.pinned: Whether to pin the scene (default: false).

update-scene.name: update-scene
update-scene.description: Update the metadata of an existing Excalidraw scene (name, pinned status, collection assignment).

params.name: New name for the scene.
params.collectionId: Move the scene to a different collection by providing its ID.

update-scene-content.name: update-scene-content
update-scene-content.description: Replace the complete drawing content of an Excalidraw scene with new elements. WARNING: this is a full replace — existing content is overwritten. Pass the full array of elements you want the scene to contain.

params.elements: Array of Excalidraw element objects (shapes, text, arrows, etc.). This replaces all existing elements.
params.appState: Optional Excalidraw app state (viewport, theme, etc.).
params.files: Optional embedded files map (e.g. images referenced in the scene).

delete-scene.name: delete-scene
delete-scene.description: Soft-delete an Excalidraw scene by moving it to trash. The scene can be recovered from the Excalidraw Plus UI.

list-collections.name: list-collections
list-collections.description: List all collections in the Excalidraw Plus workspace. Collections are folders that group related scenes together.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
params.limit: Maximum number of collections to return (default: 50).

get-collection.name: get-collection
get-collection.description: Get detailed information about a specific Excalidraw collection by its ID.

get-collection-scenes.name: get-collection-scenes
get-collection-scenes.description: List all scenes that belong to a specific Excalidraw collection.

params.collectionId: The collection ID to list scenes from.

create-collection.name: create-collection
create-collection.description: Create a new collection (folder) in the Excalidraw Plus workspace to group related scenes.

create-collection-scene.name: create-collection-scene
create-collection-scene.description: Create a new scene directly inside a specific Excalidraw collection.

params.collectionId: The collection ID to create the scene in.
params.name: Name for the new scene.
params.pinned: Whether to pin the scene (default: false).

update-collection.name: update-collection
update-collection.description: Update the metadata of an existing Excalidraw collection (e.g. rename it).

delete-collection.name: delete-collection
delete-collection.description: Soft-delete an Excalidraw collection by moving it to trash. Scenes inside are not deleted.

get-workspace.name: get-workspace
get-workspace.description: Retrieve the current Excalidraw Plus workspace's metadata, including name, users, and invites.

update-workspace.name: update-workspace
update-workspace.description: Update the current Excalidraw Plus workspace's metadata (e.g. rename it).

list-users.name: list-users
list-users.description: List all users in the Excalidraw Plus workspace with their roles and metadata.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
params.limit: Maximum number of users to return (default: 50).

get-user.name: get-user
get-user.description: Get details for a specific user in the Excalidraw Plus workspace by their user ID.

update-user.name: update-user
update-user.description: Update a workspace user in Excalidraw Plus (e.g. change their role or name).

params.name: New display name for the user.

remove-user.name: remove-user
remove-user.description: Remove a user from the Excalidraw Plus workspace, revoking their access.

params.userId: The user ID to remove from the workspace.

list-invites.name: list-invites
list-invites.description: List all pending and active invites for the Excalidraw Plus workspace.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
params.limit: Maximum number of invites to return (default: 50).

create-invite.name: create-invite
create-invite.description: Invite a user to the Excalidraw Plus workspace by email. Optionally specify their role.

params.email: Email address of the person to invite.
params.role: Role to assign (e.g. "admin", "member"). Defaults to workspace default.

get-invite.name: get-invite
get-invite.description: Get details for a specific Excalidraw Plus workspace invite by its ID.

update-invite.name: update-invite
update-invite.description: Update an existing Excalidraw Plus workspace invite (e.g. change the assigned role).

params.role: New role to assign to the invitee.

delete-invite.name: delete-invite
delete-invite.description: Delete a pending Excalidraw Plus workspace invite, revoking the invitation.

list-logs.name: list-logs
list-logs.description: Retrieve workspace audit logs from Excalidraw Plus. Useful for tracking activity, changes, and access history.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
params.limit: Maximum number of log entries to return (default: 50).

name: Excalidraw
description: Integrate with Excalidraw Plus to manage scenes, collections, workspaces, users, and invites programmatically. Create and update diagrams, wireframes, and whiteboards via the Excalidraw Plus REST API.

changelog.notes: Initial release — create, edit and organize Excalidraw whiteboards in folders, and manage workspace members and invites
